title: It’s the Golden State, not the Wild West: Attorney General Bonta Sues OpenAI Over Cybersecurity Incidents
content_md: SAN FRANCISCO, November 16 — California Attorney General Rob Bonta today filed a lawsuit against OpenAI alleging the company misled and endangered the public by knowingly developing and testing advanced artificial intelligence (AI) models without the safeguards and monitoring necessary to adequately protect the public.
